description: A one-shot kick and percussion synthesiser with two engines, a noise layer and a transient click, playing into a stereo pair of outputs

params.text: Sets the base frequency of the drum, 30Hz to 100Hz
Sets how long the drum body rings, from a click to a long tail
Sets the depth and speed of the pitch sweep at the start of the hit; at full it begins nine times the base frequency
In Pure mode morphs the waveform from sine through triangle and saw to square; in Harsh mode sets the FM index, from 2 to 8
In Pure mode fades in the second to sixth harmonics; in Harsh mode sets the FM ratio, from a half to two
Wavefolds the drum body and the noise layer, adding reflections as it is raised
Sets the level of the noise layer
Adds a short click at the attack and raises its pitch as it goes up
Sets how long the noise layer lasts
Chooses the noise layer: rumble at the bottom, crunch in the middle, dust at the top
Chooses the engine: harsh, a folded FM kick, at the bottom, and pure, six additive oscillators, at the top. It comes up on pure
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting how far the DECAY input moves the DECAY knob
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting how far the PUNCH input moves the PUNCH knob
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting how far the MORPH input moves the MORPH knob
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting how far its CV input moves the TAIL knob, despite the panel marking the pair NOISE
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting how far the FOLD input moves the FOLD knob
Fires the drum once each time it is pressed

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2V fires the drum; the voltage has to fall below 0.1V before it can fire again
Multiplies the PITCH setting by two to the power of the voltage, held between 10Hz and 2000Hz
Offsets PUNCH through its attenuverter, 5V covering the knob's full travel with the attenuverter at either extreme
Offsets MORPH through its attenuverter, 5V covering the knob's full travel with the attenuverter at either extreme
Offsets DECAY through its attenuverter, 5V covering the knob's full travel with the attenuverter at either extreme
Offsets TAIL through the attenuverter above it, 5V covering the knob's full travel with the attenuverter at either extreme, despite the panel marking the pair NOISE
Offsets FOLD through its attenuverter, 5V covering the knob's full travel with the attenuverter at either extreme
Read once at the moment of the trigger: above 1V it raises the drum body by half, leaving the noise layer at its usual level

outputs.text: The left output: the drum body, the click and one of the two noise channels, held to ±10V
The right output: the drum body, the click and the other noise channel, held to ±10V

notes: nothing comes out until the drum is fired. Send a trigger to TRIG or press TRY ME
the outputs are not a stereo pair of one sound: the drum body and click are identical in both, and only the noise layer is generated separately for each
